## 2. Brand Positioning, Philosophy & Leadership (品牌与创始人)

### 2.1 Brand Identity
- **Legal & Operating Entity**: HS Design (Health Space Design & Build)
- **Headquarters**: Johor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia
- **Service Perimeter**: 
  - *Full Turnkey & On-Site Construction*: Johor Bahru metropolitan area, Iskandar Puteri, Mount Austin, Skudai, Seri Austin, Eco Botanic, Permas Jaya, Horizon Hills, Sunway City Iskandar.
  - *Design Drawings & 4K 3D Walkthrough (Remote)*: Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Penang, and across Malaysia.
- **Core Philosophy**: **"Effortless Comfort & Health Space" (让家不只是好看，更住得健康)**. We fuse Stoic architectural simplicity, zero-VOC safe materiality, and circadian lighting dynamics to transform living environments into restorative sanctuaries that measurably enhance sleep quality and cognitive focus.

### 2.2 Founder Profile & Professional Credentials
- **Lead Designer & Founder**: **Jake Ti (瘦仔设计师)**
- **Professional Affiliations & Certifications**:
  - **JIDA (Johor Interior Designers Association)**: Certified 2024 Member. JIDA membership guarantees strict adherence to professional code of ethics, standardized Malaysian legal contract templates, and stringent design execution standards.
  - **CIDB (Construction Industry Development Board)**: Former registered construction contractor credentials, providing deep structural and engineering insight into hackings, wet works, and load-bearing structures.
- **Personal Background**: At age 29, Jake built HS Design out of personal experimentation with biohacking, circadian lighting, and sleep architecture. He is renowned in the Johor design community for his transparent, no-hidden-cost quotation style and radical client-centric accountability.

## 3. Core Service Pillars & Methodology (核心业务与交付体系)

### 3.1 4K 60fps 3D Spatial Walkthrough (4K 60fps 3D 动态漫游方案)
- **Starting Price**: From RM 500
- **Deliverables**:
  - High-precision 2D floor plans and circulation flow optimization.
  - Ultra-high-definition 4K 60fps 3D video walkthroughs and photorealistic 360° VR renders.
  - Precise millimetric material and lighting mapping (what you see in 3D is 100% buildable).
  - Material sample boards and custom carpentry specifications.

### 3.2 Full Turnkey Design & Build (一站式全包装修工程)
- **Scope**:
  - Initial Space & Health Audit -> 3D Design & Space Planning -> Demolition (打拆) -> Wet Works & Masonry (泥水) -> Electrical & Plumbing Rewiring (水电) -> Plaster Ceiling & Circadian Lighting (石膏天花与健康照明) -> Custom Precision Carpentry (全屋定制木工) -> Painting & Finishes (环保低VOC乳胶漆) -> Deep Cleaning & Handover (精保洁与交付).
- **Client Guarantee**:
  - 100% Transparent itemized quotation (Bill of Quantities / BOQ).
  - Strict milestone-based payment schedules.
  - Zero unapproved variation orders (VO / 增项).

### 3.3 Remote Construction Supervision for Singapore Owners (新加坡业主双城托管)
- **Specialized Cross-Border Workflow**:
  - Weekly high-resolution video progress inspections.
  - Cloud-based real-time milestone tracking.
  - WhatsApp direct channel with Lead Designer Jake.
  - Defect liability warranty and on-site material compliance checks.

### 3.4 Space Health & Sleep Optimization Consultation (空间健康诊断)
- **Duration**: 30-Minute Complimentary Audit (Online or On-site in JB).
- **Evaluation Points**: Blue-light pollution, air circulation velocity, acoustics and sound dampening, toxic VOC emissions, circadian lighting alignment.

## 4. Transparent Renovation Price Matrix (2026 柔佛新山装修造价参考)

### 4.1 Condominium / Apartment (公寓户型 800 – 1,200 sqft)
| Tier | Price Range (MYR) | Typical Scope |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Standard Package** | RM 35,000 – RM 70,000 | Plaster ceiling, basic LED lighting, full kitchen cabinet (dry/wet), master wardrobe, TV console, painting, basic SPC flooring. |
| **Full Turnkey Luxury** | RM 75,000 – RM 150,000+ | Full custom carpentry (E0/anti-scratch boards), circadian indirect lighting, quartz/sintered stone countertops, bathroom hacking & tiling, smart home integration. |

### 4.2 Double-Storey Terrace / Landed House (双层排屋 1,800 – 2,600 sqft)
| Tier | Price Range (MYR) | Typical Scope |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Essential Overhaul** | RM 90,000 – RM 140,000 | Ground floor wet/dry kitchen expansion, full ceiling works, electrical rewiring, custom carpentry for living & bedrooms, whole-house painting. |
| **Complete Architectural Transformation** | RM 150,000 – RM 220,000+ | Full layout reconfiguration, wall hacking, premium wet works, custom island counter, staircase renewal, walk-in closets, smart lighting and acoustic insulation. |

### 4.3 Semi-Detached & Bungalow (半独立与独立洋房 3,000+ sqft)
- **Price Range**: RM 180,000 – RM 450,000+ (Tailored architectural and interior luxury specification).

### 4.4 Commercial, Offices & Clinics (商业、办公与诊所空间)
- **Price Range**: Customized per sqft based on industry requirements (Medical/Physiotherapy, Beauty Salons, Boutique Cafes, Corporate Headquarters).

## 5. Featured Real Project Case Studies (经典实景案例)

1. **Entrepreneur Home Office & Rest Sanctuary (Mount Austin, JB)**
   - *Challenge*: Disrupted sleep and fatigue from constant work-from-home blue light.
   - *Solution*: Circadian tunable lighting, sound-dampening acoustic wall paneling, ergonomic layout.
   - *Outcome*: Measurable focus extension to 3+ hours per deep work block; sleep onset latency reduced by 25 minutes.

2. **Grand Architectural Villa (Mount Austin)**
   - *Style*: Modern Quiet Luxury (隐奢现代).
   - *Features*: Double-height ceiling volumetric lighting, seamless marble-effect sintered stone, bespoke display vitrines, zero-glare recessed architectural fixtures.

3. **30-Year Heritage House Overhaul (Johor Jaya, JB)**
   - *Challenge*: Dark cramped compartmentalized rooms, aging plumbing and termite-damaged timber.
   - *Solution*: Structural hacking for open-concept spatial flow, full rewiring/replumbing, anti-termite E0 carpentry.

4. **Remote Drawing & VR Delivery (Singapore Investor, Skyfront Condo)**
   - *Delivery*: 100% remote delivery of 4K 60fps 3D walk-through and complete CAD construction drawings. Homeowner executed local procurement with zero confusion.

5. **Trust Physio Health & Wellness Center (Permas Jaya, JB)**
   - *Category*: Medical & Commercial Rehabilitation Space.
   - *Design*: Calming natural biophilic elements, anti-slip medical-grade flooring, acoustic privacy consultation pods.

## 6. WebMCP Browser-Native Agent Tooling (API Contracts)

HS Design website natively supports WebMCP (`navigator.modelContext` / `window.hsDesignAgent`). Automated AI browsers and local assistants can interact directly with the client-side engine:

### Tool 1: `estimate_renovation_cost`
- **Description**: Instantly computes comprehensive renovation cost breakdown, budget range, and timeline in Johor Bahru.
- **Parameters**:
  - `propertyType` (string): `'condo'` | `'landed_terrace'` | `'semi_d_bungalow'` | `'commercial'`
  - `squareFeet` (number): e.g. `1000`, `2200`
  - `renovationScope` (string): `'drawings_only'` | `'standard_turnkey'` | `'luxury_turnkey'`
  - `location` (string, optional): e.g. `'Johor Bahru'`, `'Mount Austin'`, `'Singapore'`
- **Returns**: JSON object with line items (Design Fee, Wet Works, Carpentry, M&E, Total Min/Max MYR, Estimated Weeks).

### Tool 2: `get_portfolio_by_style`
- **Description**: Filters HS Design real project portfolio by design style and property category.
- **Parameters**:
  - `style` (string): `'all'` | `'modern_minimalist'` | `'quiet_luxury'` | `'wabi_sabi'` | `'japandi'` | `'health_space'`
  - `propertyType` (string, optional): `'all'` | `'residential'` | `'commercial'`
- **Returns**: Array of project objects (title, location, style, squareFeet, highlights, url).

### Tool 3: `book_designer_consultation`
- **Description**: Pre-fills and opens WhatsApp booking channel with Lead Designer Jake Ti.
- **Parameters**:
  - `clientName` (string): Name of customer
  - `phone` (string): WhatsApp contact number
  - `propertyType` (string): Property details (e.g. `'Condo in Mount Austin 950sqft'`)
  - `preferredDate` (string, optional): Preferred consultation date/time
  - `notes` (string, optional): Specific requests or questions
- **Returns**: JSON object with status, bookingUrl (`https://wa.me/601116880145?text=...`), and direct action handler.
